article_title: Massive hope for pancreatic cancer pill after trial saw tumours vanish
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on vocabulary in context, evidence-based comprehension, inference, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main assessment of daraxonrasib combined with chemotherapy?
options: It is a promising early breakthrough, but longer studies are needed before it can be considered a cure
It has already cured every patient with pancreatic cancer
It works only as a replacement for all surgery
It failed to affect tumour growth in the trial
tasks.correct_answer: It is a promising early breakthrough, but longer studies are needed before it can be considered a cure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התוצאות המוקדמות מעודדות מאוד, אך הרופאים מדגישים שעדיין לא ידוע כמה זמן ההשפעה תימשך ושאין לראות בטיפול תרופה מרפאת.

tasks.prompt: In how many trial participants did tumours become undetectable on CT scans?
options: About half of the participants
All 61 participants
Around 8%, or one in 12
Exactly 90%
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בכ־8% מהמטופלים, שהם בערך אחד מכל 12, הגידולים לא נראו עוד בסריקות CT.

tasks.prompt: Which pair of results accurately describes the early trial?
options: Tumours grew in 90%, and 8% survived
Tumours stopped growing in 90%, and just over 60% saw them shrink or disappear
All tumours vanished, but none stopped growing
Only one patient responded to treatment
tasks.correct_answer: Tumours stopped growing in 90%, and just over 60% saw them shrink or disappear
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדווחת שהגידולים הפסיקו לגדול אצל 90% מהמטופלים, ואצל מעט יותר מ־60% הם הצטמצמו או נעלמו.

tasks.prompt: What does “keep the disease at bay” mean in this context?
options: Diagnose the disease earlier
Move treatment to another hospital
Guarantee that cancer can never return
Control or delay the disease for a period of time
tasks.correct_answer: Control or delay the disease for a period of time
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי keep at bay פירושו לשלוט במחלה או לעכב אותה לזמן מה, לא בהכרח לרפא אותה.

tasks.prompt: How does daraxonrasib target pancreatic cancer?
options: It locks on to and shuts off RAS mutations that drive tumour growth
It removes the pancreas during a scan
It raises the body temperature to destroy every cell
It prevents patients from receiving chemotherapy
tasks.correct_answer: It locks on to and shuts off RAS mutations that drive tumour growth
tasks.explanation_hebrew: דאראקסונראסיב הוא מעכב KRAS שנקשר למוטציות RAS ומכבה אותן; מוטציות אלה מניעות את צמיחת הגידול.

tasks.prompt: Why are researchers interested in testing the drug beyond pancreatic cancer?
options: Pancreatic cancer never contains RAS mutations
The drug is only available outside the US
Lung, ovarian and other cancers can have similar mutations
Chemotherapy has been banned for other cancers
tasks.correct_answer: Lung, ovarian and other cancers can have similar mutations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מכיוון שגם סוגי סרטן אחרים יכולים לשאת מוטציות דומות, החוקרים מקווים שהמנגנון יועיל גם למטופלים נוספים.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the three key percentages reported from the trial.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין במדויק: עצירת צמיחה אצל 90%, הצטמקות או היעלמות אצל מעט יותר מ־60%, ואי־זיהוי בסריקות אצל כ־8% או אחד מכל 12.
expected_points: Tumours stopped growing in 90% of participants.
Just over 60% saw their tumours shrink or disappear.
Around 8%, or one in 12, had tumours become undetectable on CT scans.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences explaining why doctors are excited but still cautious about the findings.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לאזן בין שיעורי התגובה המרשימים לבין גודל המדגם הקטן, המעקב המוגבל והאפשרות שהסרטן יחזור; אין לכנות את הטיפול תרופה מרפאת.
expected_points: The 61-patient trial produced high rates of disease control and tumour response.
Some tumours became undetectable on scans.
Follow-up averaged only about a year and a half, so durability is uncertain.
Cancer can return even after scans show no sign of it, and longer studies are required.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons pancreatic cancer is described as especially difficult to treat.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים מן הכתבה: שיעור ההישרדות הנמוך ביותר מבין סוגי הסרטן הנפוצים בבריטניה, חזרת הגידול לאחר כימותרפיה, או הישרדות של חודשים בלבד במחלה מתקדמת.
expected_points: It has the lowest survival rate among common cancers in the UK.
Tumours often grow again after chemotherapy has initially shrunk them.
Most people with advanced disease survive months rather than years.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the treatment, trial results, biological mechanism and remaining uncertainty in 5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול שילוב דאראקסונראסיב וכימותרפיה, 61 משתתפים, תוצאות מרכזיות, חסימת מוטציות RAS והצורך במחקרים ארוכים יותר.
expected_points: The early trial combined daily daraxonrasib with chemotherapy in 61 people with advanced pancreatic cancer.
Tumour growth stopped in 90%, while just over 60% had shrinkage or disappearance and about 8% had no detectable tumour on CT.
The KRAS inhibitor shuts off RAS mutations that drive tumour growth.
Similar mutations in other cancers may broaden its potential use.
Longer research is needed to learn whether responses become remission or improve survival.
